message.reasoning_content:

Facts: Liu Moumou produced and sold fake traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) decoction pieces (中药饮片) without drug production qualification, using false company name (Tianma) and using another company's name (Woyang) for invoices. Also illegal drug business (unlicensed drug operation) selling to health centers. Also illegal drug distribution (unlicensed drug business) from 2007-2014, using another company's drug business qualification to sell purchased drug pieces (not fake) but without license.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售假药;非法经营<eoa>
